test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following Venn diagram, the pentagon stands for 'clerks', the triangle stands for 'coffee-lovers', the square stands for 'car-owners' and the circle stands for 'social workers'. The given letters represent the persons in that particular category. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e46397efccd0849fd52ca0d697ced9dccadabc67cfd7874322fbc84de94c420.png] 

Which of the following categories of persons is represented by the letter 'D'?

options.text: Coffee-lovers who are either car-owners or social workers
Coffee-lovers who are car-owners and social workers also
Car-owners who are coffee-lovers but not social workers
Coffee-lovers who are car-owners, social workers and clerks also

solution:
Refer to the diagram as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8afca12e08ba2557d096baa76a925b9375720bdda198bdd1fcbea58aafda71.png] 

Here, D represents Coffee-lovers who are car-owners and social workers also.

Hence, 'option(2)' is the correct answer.
